title.en: Direct Income Support vs Price Support Schemes (MSP)
title.hi: Direct Income Support vs Price Support Schemes (MSP)

rows.en: Direct cash transfer into beneficiary bank accounts without intermediaries.
rows.hi: Direct cash transfer into beneficiary bank accounts without intermediaries.

rows.en: Procurement of agricultural produce at announced Minimum Support Prices when market prices fall.
rows.hi: Procurement of agricultural produce at announced Minimum Support Prices when market prices fall.

rows.en: Generally land-holding farmer families, regardless of crop production volume.
rows.hi: Generally land-holding farmer families, regardless of crop production volume.

rows.en: Farmers who produce surplus marketable crops and actively sell at procurement centers.
rows.hi: Farmers who produce surplus marketable crops and actively sell at procurement centers.

rows.en: Minimally distortionary as it does not influence cropping pattern choices directly.
rows.hi: Minimally distortionary as it does not influence cropping pattern choices directly.

rows.en: Can lead to overproduction of water-intensive crops like paddy and wheat in specific regions.
rows.hi: Can lead to overproduction of water-intensive crops like paddy and wheat in specific regions.

rows.en: Both income support and input-subsidized schemes aim to protect farmers from climate shocks and market volatility.
rows.hi: Both income support and input-subsidized schemes aim to protect farmers from climate shocks and market volatility.

rows.en: Modern schemes heavily rely on Aadhaar authentication, Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT), and digitized land records to prevent leakages.
rows.hi: Modern schemes heavily rely on Aadhaar authentication, Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT), and digitized land records to prevent leakages.

title.en: Evolution of Agricultural Support in India
title.hi: Evolution of Agricultural Support in India

steps.en: Indirect Support Era (Input subsidies on fertilizer, power, and irrigation; MSP procurement focused on cereals).
steps.hi: Indirect Support Era (Input subsidies on fertilizer, power, and irrigation; MSP procurement focused on cereals).

steps.en: Institutional Credit and Insurance Integration (Kisan Credit Card, PM Fasal Bima Yojana).
steps.hi: Institutional Credit and Insurance Integration (Kisan Credit Card, PM Fasal Bima Yojana).

steps.en: Direct Income Support Era (Introduction of PM-KISAN for universal minimum income support to farming households).
steps.hi: Direct Income Support Era (Introduction of PM-KISAN for universal minimum income support to farming households).

clarification.en: PM-KISAN provides guaranteed income support through direct cash transfers, whereas PMFBY is a crop insurance scheme protecting against yield losses due to natural calamities.
clarification.hi: PM-KISAN provides guaranteed income support through direct cash transfers, whereas PMFBY is a crop insurance scheme protecting against yield losses due to natural calamities.

relationship.en: Accurate land records and farmer registries enabled by AgriStack ensure transparent identification and exclusion of ineligible beneficiaries in schemes like PM-KISAN.
relationship.hi: Accurate land records and farmer registries enabled by AgriStack ensure transparent identification and exclusion of ineligible beneficiaries in schemes like PM-KISAN.
